name: Default
shortDescription: Email verification HTTP API that checks whether an address exists over SMTP without sending any email.

alerts.message: Verification needs outbound connections on port 25. Many cloud providers block it; if yours does, configure a SOCKS5 proxy through the RCH__PROXY__* variables.
Every API request must send the generated RCH__HEADER_SECRET value in the x-reacher-secret header.
This image runs on x86_64 servers only.
